g.text: International Development Institute Uganda · Plot 45 Wilson Avenue, Jinja · idiu.org

svg.text: For suppliers and IDIU staff. Can't find yours? Write to Procurement.
How do I become a prequalified supplier?

g.text: Register as a supplier, choose your categories and upload the documents each one needs. IDIU Procurement checks
them, may visit your premises, and recommends; the Executive Approver decides. You get an email either way, and
your account shows where your application is.

svg.text: Can I quote if I'm not prequalified?
What happens when a document expires?
Can several people in my company use the portal?

g.text: Write to IDIU Procurement. We answer within two
